meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: Claude 会检查或配置 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步：读取 worker 状态，把 cmem.ai→Connect 给出的令牌、用户 id、SyncHub 地址写入设置文件，重启验证后报告结果。
howto.when: 当你说「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」等指令，或想查看同步状态、把记忆库备份到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 看看我的记忆云同步状态
say.note: 查询本地 worker 状态并报告结果

say.text: 帮我设置 cloud sync，这是 cmem.ai 的三个连接值
say.note: 会写入设置文件并重启验证

say.text: 把记忆同步到我的 cmem.ai 账号
say.note: 按 SyncHub 流程完成设置与验证

howto.what_en: Claude checks or configures claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro: it reads the worker's sync status, writes the token, user id, and SyncHub URL from cmem.ai → Connect into settings, restarts, verifies, and reports the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories" or "sync status", or want your memory database backed up to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Check my memory cloud sync status
say_en.note: Reads the local worker's sync status and reports it

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync; here are the three cmem.ai connection values
Sync my memories to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Runs setup and verification against SyncHub
